TRAFFIC PLAN & ADVISORY FOR  10-10-2025:- 
NH-44 (NHW)
Jammu-Srinagar NHW (NH-44) has NOT been fully restored at Tharad, Udhampur. 

There was slow movement observed on NH-44 due to single lane traffic at Tharad, breakdown of 03 HMVs and movement of 17 nomadic flocks on NH-44.   

Goods carrier (HMV/LMV) Operators carrying fresh perishable/live stock are advised to load their vehicle as per advisory issued by Traffic Police Headquarters time to time as there is single lane traffic and poor condition of road at Tharad (Udhampur), at Nashri-Dalwas and between Marog & Kishtwari Pather, also heavy movement of nomadic flocks on NH-44 .

 Commuters are advised to follow lane discipline; overtaking, wrong lane driving will cause congestion . Avoid travel on NH-44, in view of heavy movement of nomadic herds, if not necessary.

Subject to fair weather and good road condition, tomorrow only one way traffic for LMVs shall be permitted from Srinagar towards Jammu on  NH-44.

These vehicles shall be allowed from NAVYUG Tunnel (Qazigund side) between 0700 hrs to 1000 hrs

No LMV shall be allowed from Jammu  towards Srinagar on NH-44. 

LMVs going towards Distt. Doda, Kishtwar and Ramban from Jammu shall be allowed from Nagrota (Jammu) between 0700 hrs 1000 hrs.  However, LMVs coming from Distt. Doda, Kishtwar and Ramban towards Jammu  will be permitted to move but these vehicles must cross the Nashri Tunnel before 1000 hrs.

Mughal road is open for LMVs from Jammu towards Srinagar and vice versa. 

HMVs/Load Carriers:- 
Subject to fair weather and better road conditions, HMVs shall be allowed from Jakheni (Udhampur) towards Srinagar only after the down HMV tail crosses  Tharad (Udhampur).  TCU Udhampur shall liaise with TCU Ramban before releasing the HMVs.. 

SFs Convoy Movement:-
Security Forces are advised/requested not to ply against advisory /traffic plan in view of possible traffic congestion because of narrow carriage way between Tharad and Balinallah/Marog and Kishtwar Pathar on Jammu-Srinagar NHW. Tomorrow they may ply from Jammu towards Srinagar after confirming the status of NHW from TCU Ramban.

Kishtwar- Sinthan- Anantnag NH-244:- 
Kishtwar-Sinthan-Anantnag road is still closed due to snow accumulation. 

SSG ROAD  
Subject to fair weather and good road condition, (after getting green signal from the BRO) traffic movement shall be allowed on regulated manner on Srinagar-Sonamarg-Gumari road. LMVs followed by HMVs shall be allowed from Minamarg towards Srinagar at 0500 hrs. to 1000 hrs. Similarly, LMVs followed by HMVs shall be allowed from Sonamarg towards Kargil at 1130 hrs to 1730 hrs . No vehicle shall be allowed after cut off timing. 
SFs Convoy, plying from Srinagar to Kargil and vice versa shall plan their movement in such a manner so that Civil Traffic (both UP and DOWN) don't get disturbed.

Mughal Road:- 
Subject to fair weather and good road condition, after getting green signal from Road maintenance agencies (GREF). LMVs Passenger/Private Cars shall be allowed from both sides viz Jammu towards Srinagar and vice versa via Poonch. These vehicles shall be allowed from Behramgala (Baffliaz) between 0600 hrs. to 1730 hrs  and from Herpora (shopian) between 0600 hrs and 1700 hrs as per advisory issued by District Magistrate Poonch vide  No. DMP/J/9291-9318 dated 31-08-2025. However, HMVs carrying fresh fruits six tyres only shall be allowed from Shopian towards Poonch. No HMV will be allowed from Jammu towards Mughal road. TCU Jammu and TCU Srinagar will inform all concerned about the traffic advisory and cut off timings.

CUT OFF TIMINGS FOR LMVs/PASSENGER/PRIVATE CARs GOING TOWARDS SRINAGAR VIA MUGHAL ROAD- 
Akhnoor 1230 hrs
Bhambla 1330 hrs
Rajouri 1530 hrs
Manjakote 1600 hrs
Surankote 1700 hrs
Behramgala 1730 hrs

 ADVISORY :- 
People are advised to undertake journey only after confirming status of the road from Traffic control units as under:-  
•Jammu (0191-2459048, 0191- 2740550, 9419147732, 103)
•Srinagar (0194-2450022, 2485396, 18001807091, 103)
•Ramban (9419993745, 1800-180-7043)
•Udhampur (8491928625) 
•PCR Kishtwar  (9906154100) 
•PCR Kargil (9541902330, 9541902331
@Traffic_hqrs

Islamabad Traffic Advisory – Friday, October 10, 2025
_______________
The Al Quds March, organized by Tehreek-e-Labbaik Pakistan (TLP), will take place after Friday prayers on October 10, 2025. The rally will begin at Faizabad and end at the U.S. Embassy.

Traffic Diversion Plan:
The route from Nawaz Chowk to Faisal Avenue will be closed. Motorists are advised to use the following alternate routes:

Zero Point to Faisal Avenue: via F-8 Service Road and Parveen Shakir Road

Faisal Chowk to Zero Point: via Parveen Shakir Road and F-8 Service Road

Nawaz Chowk to F-7: via F-7 Service Road

Public Advisory:
Plan travel to avoid delays. Follow instructions from law enforcement officials. Stay informed through FM 92.4 and official traffic advisories.

#TLPProtest #Islamabad
